title: Chu Berry's influence and the Benny Carter arrangements
summary: Chu Berry influenced Calloway to bring fresh music into the band, including Benny Carter arrangements like Change Partners and Dance.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: I remember, too, when -- we had a lot of good guys come through there. And I think Chu Choo Berry, would you agree with me that Chu Choo Berry was a great influence on us getting a lot of fresh music into that band?
Yes, Cab had a sort of a nice feeling about Chu Choo and would take his advice.
Oh, yes, he liked Chu Choo very much. He liked Chu Choo very much. He had a great admiration for Chu Choo, you know.

Oh, yeah. Let's 'Change Partners and Dance.' Yes, yes, yes.
Oh, that was a beautiful arrangement.
A beautiful arrangement. Wasn't it, though?
